ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a distribution map of part of the intercity rapid rail transit in the Pearl River Delta, in which cities such as Guangzhou, Foshan, Dongguan, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Zhongshan, and Jiangmen can be seen, and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macao Special Administrative Region are marked; the region is located on the southern coast of our country, close to the South China Sea. Then reason: the question stem asks about the heat conditions in the Pearl River Delta region. The Pearl River Delta is located in the low-latitude coastal area of southern China, with a relatively large solar altitude, mild winters, and a long frost-free period; therefore the heat conditions are good, manifested as abundant heat.
